additional_info.subject: Internal note
RE: 0417145 - ID0417145-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / R6 170002059] Charging issue CRM:00641001247
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well.
As we discussed on team call, we have reviewed the logs on the SCB and AWS server over the past month and observed a continuous IMD_BC2 Bender shoes error. This might be due to a loose connection, which needs to be checked. We recommend planning for a site intervention to ensure all the wirings are properly tightened and the settings are correct.
If the wiring and settings are fine, the Bender might be faulty and may need replacement if required.
Please refer to the error descriptions captured during our observation
Spare part-: 8EM5903-0AA00-0AA1, Insulation Monit Device
Thank you for your patience and understanding.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
